description: Arus Harian — daily flow puzzle game for Reddit (Devvit Web). A new 7x7 current maze every day; rotate arrows to guide the orb to the Goal.
name: arus-harian

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:types
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.shared.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
